summary: Iteration 47 — verified the three new features end-to-end. Backend: 30 pytest cases across gift-card store credit (credit-only Stripe+PayPal, partial reserve + credit-release, atomicity/no-negative under 6 concurrent requests, cross-user release blocked), Find Your Path quiz (5 answer combos incl. beginner+foundations->Core 26+/online_only and advanced+mastery->Core 84/vip), Printful Part B (status guard payments_live=false, stores list w/ counts incl. store 16428293 = 36 products, image hosts, draft readback, admin-only guards, webhook idempotency) and auth-playbook checks. 29 passed, 1 failed (CORS allow_credentials), 1 skipped (superseded). Frontend: quiz wizard (5 steps, back, both CTAs, mobile), homepage home-quiz-cta, student credit-only checkout on /passes (drop_in $22 and class_pack $99 both completed with NO gateway; credit 245->223->124, passes 11->12->17), unchecked toggle correctly falls back to a real Stripe redirect, and admin Orders & Fulfillment 'Send draft' (order went skipped_test_mode -> PRINTFUL: DRAFT) + Refresh tracking + Shop&Printful pane store select/fulfill toggle showing 'test mode'. Test-mode guard verified end-to-end: a credit-paid cart order with a Printful product got printful_status='skipped_test_mode' and NO printful_order_id.

critical.issue: Reserved store credit is STRANDED on abandonment. Partial-credit Stripe sessions deduct credit immediately, but /api/checkout/credit-release has zero callers: grep shows no frontend call and no expiry sweeper, and Stripe cancel_url is '/checkout/cancel' with no session_id so the UI cannot release it. A user who closes/cancels Stripe permanently loses the reserved credit until an admin intervenes.

minor.issue: allow_credentials=False with allow_origins='*', yet /api/auth/login sets an httpOnly access_token cookie — the cookie can never be sent cross-origin. Playbook item 'CORS allows credentials with explicit origins' not met (app works because the SPA uses Bearer tokens). Decide: either drop the cookie or set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly + allow_credentials=True.
Store credit is applied 1:1 across currencies (100 USD credit reduced a €199 program to €99 charge) — known simplification, but no FX note is surfaced to the user.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Fulfill now' (confirm=true) submits a REAL, chargeable Printful order on a single click with no confirm() dialog or 'are you sure' step — one misclick in the admin console spends money.

React console error on the Shop & Printful pane: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option> ... will cause a hydration error' (some text wrapper renders a span inside <option>). Functionality unaffected but it pollutes the console.

issues: quiz-membership-card shows only name + billing cycle ('Essential / Monthly Plan') with no price, so the user cannot compare tiers before clicking through
Option sub-labels and the trailing arrow glyph on quiz cards use very light grey (#9AA096-ish) on white — borderline contrast on mobile

action_items: Wire up /api/checkout/credit-release: pass session_id into Stripe cancel_url (and store it client-side) so CheckoutCancel releases the reservation, and/or add a background sweeper that releases credit_applied for unpaid transactions older than ~30-60 min.
Add a confirmation step to admin 'Fulfill now' (order-fulfill-<id>) since it submits a real paid Printful order.
Decide the cookie/CORS story: either remove the httpOnly login cookie or configure explicit CORS_ORIGINS + allow_credentials=True.
Show the membership price on quiz-membership-card.
Fix the <span> inside <option> React warning in ProductsPane's store select.
critical_code_review_comments: payments.py::_reserve_store_credit is correctly atomic (conditional $gte update) — verified: 6 concurrent credit-only drop_in requests produced exactly 1 credit_only purchase and never a negative balance.

printful.py::try_auto_fulfill_order correctly short-circuits on _is_live_payments() and writes printful_status='skipped_test_mode' — verified end-to-end with a credit-paid cart order (no printful_order_id created).
credit-release is user-scoped (admin got 404 on another user's session) and idempotent (credit_released flag) — good; it just has no caller.
Credit reservation happens BEFORE the Stripe session is created and is released on exception, but there is no compensating action for the far more likely 'user abandons Stripe' path.

success_rate.backend: 97% (29/30 assertions-suites passed; only the CORS playbook check failed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed (quiz, homepage CTA, credit-only checkout, gateway fallback, admin draft fulfilment)

Throwaway users TEST_credit_*@example.com and TEST_race_*@example.com created via /auth/register. One paid cart order 2c1d9485-2c26-4eaf-8e85-352effebe634 (Yoga mat, €47) paid entirely with credit and then sent to Printful as a DRAFT via the admin UI (no charge; delete the draft in Printful if unwanted). confirm=true was never called.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md present and valid (admin tony@tonyyoga.com, student student@demo.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest tests/test_iteration47*.py` from /app/backend (pytest.ini adds xdist; use -o addopts='' with -s to see prints). The only expected failure today is test_iteration47_auth::test_cors_allows_credentials_with_explicit_origin. For partial-credit tests always register a fresh user (test_iteration47_partial pattern) — student@demo.com accumulates credit and makes the partial path skip. Never call /api/admin/orders/{id}/fulfill?confirm=true (real chargeable Printful order); confirm=false drafts are safe. Printful catalogue currently: 40 products total, store 16428293 reports 36; image hosts files.cdn.printful.com (23) + tonyoga.online (17), none missing.
rca_of_the_issue: Stranded credit: create_checkout reserves credit via _reserve_store_credit before creating the Stripe session and stores credit_applied on the transaction, but the only recovery path (/checkout/credit-release) is never invoked — the Stripe cancel_url omits session_id and CheckoutCancel (frontend/src/pages/Checkout.jsx:95) renders a static message with no API call; there is also no TTL sweeper for 'initiated'/'open' transactions. Reproduce: fresh user with 100 credit -> POST /api/checkout/session {item_type:'program', apply_credit:true} -> balance 0 -> abandon the Stripe URL -> balance stays 0 forever.
